name: crontab-list-is-not-gated-by-persistence
note: GUARD: the persistence gate targets only the write/edit variant. `crontab -l` (list) surfaces no sched.cron capability, so the new gate does not fire. With no rule allowing a bare crontab -l it fails closed to gommage; the point is that it does NOT become an ask_picto for sched.cron:edit.
